user.title: Pick your kiosk
user.description: Select the Kiosk Satellite tablet from its ESPHome device. The backup entities are added to that device and the admin URL is taken from its Remote admin sensor, so IP changes are followed automatically. Leave empty to enter a kiosk manually.

credentials.title: Connect to {name}
credentials.description: Enter the remote admin URL (default port {port}) and the admin password set on the kiosk. The password is used once to get a long-lived token and is not stored.

data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for the kiosk's built-in self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The kiosk at {url} rejected the stored token. Enter the admin password to get a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the kiosk. Check the URL and that Remote management is on.

data_description.keep: Older backups for this kiosk are deleted after each new one.

backup.name: Back up kiosks
backup.description: Exports the full configuration of one or more kiosks to <config>/kiosk_satellite_backups.

config_entry_id.name: Kiosks
config_entry_id.description: Kiosks to back up. Leave empty to back up all of them.

restore.name: Restore kiosk
restore.description: Pushes a stored backup back to a kiosk. The kiosk applies it immediately.

file.name: Backup file
file.description: File name of the backup to restore. Leave empty for the newest.

adopt_identity.name: Adopt identity
adopt_identity.description: Take over the backup's device name and ESPHome node name. Turn off when cloning to a different tablet.

import_local_storage.name: Import page data
import_local_storage.description: Also restore the dashboard page's saved data, including the Voice Satellite selection. Turn off when cloning.

unknown_entry.message: No Kiosk Satellite Backup entry with id {entry_id}.

no_backups.message: There are no stored backups for {name}.
